dollars: e/m in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars; e2019 in 2019 inflation-adjusted dollars (nominal, not CPI-adjusted); g = (e - e2019)/e2019*100
api: https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5?get=NAME,B25064_001E,B25064_001M&for=tract:*&in=state:XX&in=county:* (key now required; summary files used instead)

legend.e: median gross rent 2020-2024 ACS 5-yr ($); 3501 = Census top-code meaning 3,500 or more (m omitted)
legend.m: MOE (90%) ($); omitted when Census publishes a sentinel
legend.e2019: median gross rent 2015-2019 ACS 5-yr ($) for the same tract footprint

changeRule: e2019/g only when the 2020 tract matches one 2010 tract with >= 99% mutual area overlap (Census tab20_tract20_tract10_natl.txt); split/merged tracts skipped. 9 matched tracts carry a different 2010 GEOID (renumbered, same footprint).
